about.title: More Than a Venue. A Place to Gather.
paragraphs: Set in the heart of Nyamata, Bugesera District, Naioth Ramah Centre is a beautiful and spacious destination designed to welcome people for life's most meaningful occasions.
From an elegant wedding celebration to a 1,000-person conference, a private family gathering or a corporate event, our venue combines space, beauty and convenience in one exceptional setting.

And because the moments before an event matter too, our dedicated one-day preparation house provides a private space for the bride, groom or event hosts to prepare, relax and get ready for the occasion.
